description.narrative: Disaster Management Capacity Building Programme Portfolio Title : National Society Development Initiative (NSDI) Somalia Start and end dates: 01/01/2019 31/12/2021 Pcode: P8078 Summary: BRC will work with movement partners to support the NSD of the Somalia Red Crescent. Support will include BRC funding technical expertise problem-solving and a seconded NSD specialist to the ICRC Somalia delegation. This project aims to incrementally increase the impact of the NS s operations and sustainability. Location: Somalia Beneficiaries: NA Donor: BRC GF PNSs/Partners: Somali RC ICRC IFRC Norwegian RC Budget: 350 000 budget per year GF Current situation (Jan 2020): SRCS with our support established an inclusive steering committee (management structure for the initiative) to agree a plan the use of these funds and provide oversight. Members include the SRCS BRC NRC IFRC and ICRC. The SRCS President chairs this steering committee and the BRC is joint secretariat. The BRC has relinquished direct oversight of the project funds to the steering committee thus ensuring that this is an inclusive movement approach. The BRC has seconded a NSD delegate to the ICRC to support the process. This individual has the office next to the President and is accountable to the steering committee. BRC and ICRC to view this initiative as an example of operationalizing the Cooperation Framework between the two organizations.
